blurb: Salt Creek Wranglers is a 501c3 non-profit organization located in Lincoln, Nebraska. Wranglers hosts competitive open horse shows during the spring and summer months. Any breed of horse or pony can compete (registration not required), and equestrians of all ages, experience levels, and abilities
